verses: A Maskil of Asaf. O God, why hast Thou cast us off for ever? why does Thy anger smoke against the sheep of Thy pasture?
Remember Thy congregation, which Thou hast purchased of old; the tribe of Thy inheritance, which Thou hast redeemed; this mount Żiyyon, wherein Thou hast dwelt.
Lift up Thy feet to the perpetual desolations; the enemy has destroyed everything in the sanctuary.
Thy enemies roar in the midst of thy meeting place; they set up their signs for signs:
they are known as swingers of axes upwards in the thick forest:
and now they break down its carved work altogether with hatchet and with hammers.
They have burned Thy sanctuary with fire, to the ground: they have defiled the dwelling place of Thy name.
They have said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the meeting places of God in the land.
We see not our signs: there is no longer a prophet: nor is there among us any that knows how long.
O God, how long shall the adversary insult? shall the enemy blaspheme Thy name for ever?
Why dost Thou withdraw Thy hand, even Thy right hand? out of Thy bosom with it! destroy!
for God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
Thou didst divide the sea by Thy strength: Thou didst break the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.
Thou didst crush the heads of livyatan: thou didst give him for food to the desert people.
Thou didst split open springs and wadis: Thou didst dry up the ever flowing streams.
The day is Thine, the night also is Thine: Thou hast prepared the light and the sun.
Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: Thou hast made summer and winter.
Remember this, how the enemy has insulted the Lord, and how a base people have blasphemed Thy name.
O deliver not the soul of Thy turtledove to the wild beast: forget not the congregation of Thy poor for ever.
Look upon the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full, the habitations of cruelty.
O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise Thy name.
Arise, O God, plead Thy own cause: remember how the foolish man insults Thee daily.
Forget not the voice of Thy enemies: the tumult of those who rise up against Thee increases continually.
